mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. Temperatures are at 60 degrees under clear skies along the Military Ridge State Trail. The air quality index is at 82, so keep that in mind. We have a waxing gibbous moon, and while the ISS passes overhead tonight, we will not be able to see it due to the clouds. Tonight will cool down to a low of 53 degrees with no rain predicted.

City Hall is busy with the upcoming November 4 Plan Commission meeting. Officials will review several proposals, including the Ardent Glen development and a new site plan at 1979 Milky Way. Additionally, tax bills will be mailed out by December 15, and residents are reminded of the two-installment payment options available through the City Treasurer.

Today features live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, the Dane County Farmers' Market returns to the Square in Madison, and Paddy Mac's continues its music series. Looking further ahead, mark your calendar for trivia nights at various local venues starting next week.

On October 15, the Verona Police Department responded to a report of dangerous driving involving a school bus. Officers successfully arrested the driver for O W I. No injuries were reported, and the department is currently investigating a potential collision with a traffic sign.
Our flavor of the day is the delicious Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. Culver's of Verona is currently open and serving until 10:30 PM tonight, so stop by soon to grab a treat before we close.
